description:
Transcribe a WhatsApp audio / voice note to text (read-only: nothing is sent or changed on WhatsApp). Give message_id + chat (an audio received in this account, from whatsapp_messages) OR url (an audio file link from this platform's own media storage: the screen upload ref or a whatsapp_get_media url; other hosts are refused). Up to 10 minutes of audio (duration read from the file). Returns { success:true, text, duration_s, model, language }. On failure returns { success:false, error }: not_found, media_expired (WhatsApp no longer has the file), too_long (> 10 min or > 16 MB), unsupported (not an audio / format not accepted / url not ours), transcription_failed, rate_limited.

Bulk support: accepts message_ids for batched execution.
name: whatsapp_transcribe_media
